title: Term Life Insurance Reinstatement Interest: Relationship Share for Whole Life Insurance and Universal Life Insurance Owners
content:
**Relationship terms — Term Life Insurance reinstatement.** The share of the reinstatement interest charged follows the owner's other Ashgrove life policies, as shown on the owner's Whole Life Insurance and Universal Life Insurance policy records:

| The owner holds, in force | Share of the interest charged |
|---|---|
| both an Ashgrove whole life policy and an Ashgrove universal life policy | one half (0.5) |
| exactly one of them | three quarters (0.75) |
| neither | the whole interest |

Only a permanent policy whose status is in force counts.

**Cases (hypothetical).** Interest before the share of 20.00: an owner holding an in-force Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 65 and an in-force Ashgrove Protection UL is charged 10.00; an owner holding only the universal life policy, 15.00; an owner whose whole life policy has been surrendered and who holds no universal life policy, 20.00.
